- [My Race Setup](/work/my-race-setup): subscription SaaS rebuilt in a team of two; AI Crew Chief on Claude with web search; Stripe billing
- [AmeriCorps](/work/americorps): led a backend team of ~15 developers at Devsinc; Android/iOS apps with Ionic and Capacitor
- [Teranet Undertakings](/work/teranet-undertakings): ~15 .NET 9 microservices monitoring 10,000+ properties for 50 tenants
- [MCP Server](/work/mcp-server): read-only Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants
